race.comment: DON'T TOUCH (2) was far from disgraced when finishing fifth over 1100m at Rockhampton last start, beaten only by 3 lengths. She seems to be at her best over the short-course sprint trips for now, and she is nicely placed to take this out. BOOMTIME NOW (3) was safely held at a recent Goondiwindi picnic meeting last time out but was an easy Moree maiden winner before that. He drops 3.5kg and is worth another chance. SUTHERLAND (1) showed improvement when finishing fourth at Goondiwindi last start and her record on this circuit is very strong. Stick with her on an each-way basis. TERRITORY ASH (5) resumes from a spell for the first time from the Sweeney stable, and she is not the worst in this at good odds. LITTLE VAIN (4) resumes from a spell, and with the aid of a good draw, she can figure in the top 4. Check the market moves.
